model: Trusted self-hosted extension application plus gateway adapter, including dynamic-routing composition contracts

legend.supported: Relevant gateway/runtime mechanism exists; scoped prior tests only
legend.owned: Extension can implement this itself; no specialized host service required
legend.integration: Feasible building blocks, but gateway boundary/coverage/control still needs integration
legend.gap: A retained host boundary lacks the requested guarantee
legend.optional: Not required for trusted self-hosted extensions

rows.requirement: Replace inbound authentication

ccr.detail: Core beforeAuth can reject; built-in auth/introspection remains a distinct layer.

cpa.detail: FrontendAuthProviderExclusive replaces ordinary request auth; management auth is separate.

bifrost.detail: HTTP pre-auth translates credentials or denies; stock governance remains authoritative.

rows.requirement: Choose account / upstream route

ccr.detail: routeResolvers can return dynamic provider configs and fallback lists.

cpa.detail: Scheduler and ModelRouter over host-eligible candidates; not unrestricted retry ownership.

bifrost.detail: Plugin can pin eligible keys; full Account / KeySelector replacement requires SDK/custom host.

rows.requirement: Replace credentials / implement refresh

ccr.detail: ProviderPlugin.authenticate replaces upstream credentials; refresh service is plugin-owned.

cpa.detail: AuthProvider parse/login/poll/refresh plus managed auth callbacks; live OAuth untested.

bifrost.detail: Custom Account in SDK; stock plugin loader does not register a general refresh provider.

rows.requirement: Own account catalog, labels and client ACLs

ccr.detail: Own database/UI/ACL engine; apply committed eligibility via route and authenticate hooks.

cpa.detail: Own catalog/ACL engine is feasible. Reconcile host auth records and reapply eligibility on selections/fallbacks; host.auth.delete is absent.

bifrost.detail: Own catalog/UI is feasible. Integrate with built-in key/virtual-key policy or custom SDK Account; stock plugin cannot replace every account service.

rows.original_requirement: Account CRUD / label / client ACL model

rows.requirement: Serve public enrollment POST and private service auth

ccr.detail: Own HTTP server handles POST /start, cookies and private-service authentication. No gateway route registrar is required. Publishing usable credentials is a separate integration requirement.

cpa.detail: Own HTTP server handles POST /start, cookies and private-service authentication. No gateway route registrar is required. Publishing usable credentials is a separate integration requirement.

bifrost.detail: Own HTTP server handles POST /start, cookies and private-service authentication. No gateway route registrar is required. Publishing usable credentials is a separate integration requirement.

rows.original_requirement: Public enrollment POST + private service auth

rows.requirement: Run separate public enrollment listener/process

ccr.detail: Own listener on another port or supervised companion process. A second port alone is not process/credential isolation; separate processes and stores can implement that boundary.

cpa.detail: Own listener on another port or supervised companion process. A second port alone is not process/credential isolation; separate processes and stores can implement that boundary.

bifrost.detail: Own listener on another port or supervised companion process. A second port alone is not process/credential isolation; separate processes and stores can implement that boundary.

rows.requirement: Commit activation, labels and notification outbox

ccr.detail: Keep authoritative activation, labels and outbox in one plugin database transaction; route/auth hooks read only committed eligible accounts. This architecture is feasible, not implemented/tested.

cpa.detail: Own activation/labels/outbox can be atomic. Host credential-file/runtime publication is a second system; use reconciliation plus authoritative eligibility checks, not an assumed cross-store transaction.

bifrost.detail: Own activation/labels/outbox can be atomic. Stock key store/routing must honor that decision; use reconciled publication/eligibility or SDK Account wiring.

rows.requirement: Quota snapshots / per-attempt outcomes

ccr.detail: Account connectors, provider hooks and billing/trace events; exact Broker policy is own work.

cpa.detail: QuotaProvider and UsagePlugin include account/failure metadata.

bifrost.detail: Core key retries and trace spans; broker-specific quota refresh/store is own work.

rows.requirement: Rewrite request / instructions / tool schemas

ccr.detail: Raw body + standard request transforms before routing/upstream.

cpa.detail: Interceptors, body patchers and translators.

bifrost.detail: PreRequest / PreLLM typed mutation and HTTP hooks.

rows.requirement: Modify ordinary nonstream response

ccr.detail: Provider and final response hooks; virtual model final hook differs.

cpa.detail: ResponseInterceptor and translation stages.

bifrost.detail: PostLLM and HTTP transport post hooks.

rows.requirement: Modify ordinary live stream

ccr.detail: streamHooks wrap upstream Response on ordinary paths.

cpa.detail: StreamChunkInterceptor + host streaming callbacks; host adds terminal marker.

bifrost.detail: Typed post hooks and transport chunk interceptor; drop/abort semantics tested.

rows.requirement: Same output hooks cover hidden tool loops

ccr.detail: Virtual nonstream bypasses final response hook; optimistic virtual stream bypasses stream hook.

cpa.detail: Nested model calls skip caller interceptor; no generic host tool loop to cover.

bifrost.detail: Nonstream continuations reenter core; no streaming agent loop. Coverage depends on role/path.

rows.original_requirement: Same output hooks cover hidden tool loops

rows.requirement: Add new wire protocol through plugin

ccr.detail: sourceAdapters + targetAdapters; preservation must be implemented/tested by adapter.

cpa.detail: Custom translator formats/executors; new inbound HTTP endpoints require host/service work.

bifrost.detail: Custom provider based on existing wire formats; entirely new protocols require host integration.

rows.original_requirement: Add new wire protocol through plugin

rows.requirement: Serve arbitrary HTTP endpoints and dashboard

ccr.detail: Trusted extension can bind its own HTTP server or call a companion in any language. Restrictions on the gateway-owned router do not block this. Same gateway port/prefix remains an optional integration.

cpa.detail: Trusted extension can bind its own HTTP server or call a companion in any language. Restrictions on the gateway-owned router do not block this. Same gateway port/prefix remains an optional integration.

bifrost.detail: Trusted extension can bind its own HTTP server or call a companion in any language. Restrictions on the gateway-owned router do not block this. Same gateway port/prefix remains an optional integration.

rows.requirement: Own WebSocket service / modify gateway WebSockets

ccr.detail: Own WebSocket listener is feasible. Interception of the gateway existing Responses/MCP sockets remains unverified; a new port does not create those hooks.

cpa.detail: Own WebSocket service is feasible; stock upstream observer is not a generic bidirectional mutation/upgrade API.

bifrost.detail: Own WebSocket service is feasible; modifying built-in realtime connections still depends on their hook coverage.

rows.requirement: Own durable storage and tenant scoping

ccr.detail: Use own SQLite/Postgres/files, migrations, tenant namespaces and credentials. A host database API is optional. No new restart or isolation validation was performed.

cpa.detail: Use own SQLite/Postgres/files, migrations, tenant namespaces and credentials. A host database API is optional. No new restart or isolation validation was performed.

bifrost.detail: Use own SQLite/Postgres/files, migrations, tenant namespaces and credentials. A host database API is optional. No new restart or isolation validation was performed.

rows.requirement: Archive successfully before returning reduced context

ccr.detail: One extension awaits its durable archive commit before returning a reduced request. On failure return unchanged history or explicit denial. Hooks provide the basic mechanism; do not reduce in an earlier independent hook.

cpa.detail: One extension awaits its durable archive commit before returning a reduced request. On failure return unchanged history or explicit denial. Hooks provide the basic mechanism; do not reduce in an earlier independent hook.

bifrost.detail: One extension awaits its durable archive commit before returning a reduced request. On failure return unchanged history or explicit denial. Hooks provide the basic mechanism; do not reduce in an earlier independent hook.

rows.requirement: Own context revisions, locks and concurrent state

ccr.detail: Implement revisions/CAS, per-session locks, leases and restart recovery in own state service. Require reliable caller/session identifiers from traffic; the host need not implement a context database.

cpa.detail: Implement revisions/CAS, per-session locks, leases and restart recovery in own state service. Require reliable caller/session identifiers from traffic; the host need not implement a context database.

bifrost.detail: Implement revisions/CAS, per-session locks, leases and restart recovery in own state service. Require reliable caller/session identifiers from traffic; the host need not implement a context database.

rows.requirement: Reconcile private continuations with client replay

ccr.detail: Own replay database/transform is feasible. Built-in virtual loop does not expose complete private replay automatically; record via controlled tool path or own orchestrator. Existing hidden-result replay failure still applies to default loop.

cpa.detail: Own orchestrator can record continuations and reapply them via request hooks/host.model.execute. No supplied complete implementation or end-to-end replay proof.

bifrost.detail: Own replay database is feasible. Must capture tool/continuation events before lossy built-in mixed summaries or own the orchestration path; exact coverage needs verification.

rows.original_requirement: Restore private continuation on client replay

rows.requirement: Compaction with provider-held / signed state

ccr.detail: Built-in client compaction code exists; full opaque/state preservation not tested.

cpa.detail: Translations exist; proposed compactor must resolve provider-held state explicitly.

bifrost.detail: Provider compaction exists; extension rewrite/state fidelity not established.

rows.requirement: Provide executable internal tools

ccr.detail: Extension can run its own MCP tool server and use virtual profiles. Trusted request/session context still needs integration.

cpa.detail: Own tool dispatcher inside custom executor/orchestrator; host.model.execute and streams provide model-call primitives. Generic host tool registration is not required if extension owns loop.

bifrost.detail: Extension can run an operator-configured MCP server; SDK also offers RegisterMCPTool. Stock dynamic plugin is not automatically given that SDK instance.

rows.requirement: Implement nonstream model/tool continuation

ccr.detail: Existing virtual/transparent tool loops can be reused; own orchestration remains possible through plugin HTTP/provider integration.

cpa.detail: Own loop can use tested nested host.model.execute calls. Must implement tool ownership, IDs, budgets and replay; lack of built-in loop is no longer a categorical blocker.

bifrost.detail: Built-in nonstream MCP agent mode supplies continuation. An independent loop can instead call inference API, with explicit identity/recursion/accounting handling.

rows.requirement: Implement streaming model/tool continuation

ccr.detail: Existing optimistic loop works but has hook/identity/replay gaps. Own orchestrator can replace that path; exact integration must be demonstrated.

cpa.detail: Custom executor plus host model stream open/read/close and emit callbacks are usable building blocks for own streaming loop. Complete protocol/terminal control remains unproven.

bifrost.detail: Built-in Agent Mode remains nonstreaming. Own service can call streaming inference endpoints and own client output, or use a custom host; not an automatically composable stock hook.

rows.requirement: Preserve mixed client/internal calls and IDs

ccr.detail: Own coordinator can implement this; reusing the default virtual loop retains its tested skip/fold limitations.

cpa.detail: Own coordinator handles internal tools, yields client calls, persists pairing and resumes. Public execution bridges help; full mixed-stream/replay behavior not tested.

bifrost.detail: Own coordinator can avoid name-keyed summaries. Default mixed agent path still loses repeated same-name results; hooking after loss cannot recover them.

rows.requirement: Bind trusted caller/session to tool execution

ccr.detail: Own service can issue trusted scoped invocation handles and store identity. Built-in virtual MCP path lacks trusted per-request session propagation; another port alone does not fix this.

cpa.detail: Own orchestrator can bind frontend principal/CallerScope and an explicit conversation ID to tool calls. Derived session IDs are not authoritative identity.

bifrost.detail: Own service can bind request identity; local tool callback args-only and MCP identity propagation still require a deliberate integration.

rows.original_requirement: Trusted tenant/session context in tool execution

rows.requirement: Cancellation through every internal tool

ccr.detail: Transport abort exists; virtual tool call does not receive client abort signal.

cpa.detail: Host callbacks cancel; arbitrary native execution continues until it cooperates.

bifrost.detail: Canceled loop still dispatches mock callbacks; downstream must enforce; local tool callback lacks context.

rows.requirement: Bound tool turns, spend and parallel work

ccr.detail: Own loop/worker pool can enforce budgets and semaphores; built-in virtual loop already has turn/call limits. Cancellation boundary remains R26.

cpa.detail: Own orchestration enforces rounds, spend, queue limits and concurrency. Lack of a host continuation budget is not a blocker under this model; native cancellation remains R26.

bifrost.detail: Own loop/MCP service can bound admission. Reusing built-in agent fan-out does not automatically inherit those limits; avoid or wrap that path. R26 covers cancellation.

rows.requirement: Independent request/response/usage extension

ccr.detail: Transforms plus billing publishers/outboxes; virtual stream hooks need separate coverage.

cpa.detail: UsagePlugin separate from mutators; raw transcript visibility depends on chain order.

bifrost.detail: HTTP/LLM hooks and independent ObservabilityPlugin.Inject traces.

rows.requirement: Actual usage retained before presentation edits

ccr.detail: 18 real vs 1998 displayed verified; billing event hooks may mutate/drop before sinks.

cpa.detail: 10 real vs 1998 displayed verified on OpenAI-compatible route; not all translators.

bifrost.detail: Core traces capture usage before ordinary post hooks; full independent ledger not validated.

rows.original_requirement: Actual usage retained before presentation edits

rows.requirement: Account for internal model calls / attempts

ccr.detail: Two-call loop aggregates 36; all failed-provider cases not tested.

cpa.detail: Nested host.model.execute + 429 failover each emit usage; generic host.http does not.

bifrost.detail: Continuation usage and per-attempt traces tested; avoid double-counting aggregated result.

rows.original_requirement: Account for internal model calls / attempts

rows.requirement: Reliable lifecycle / attempt correlation

ccr.detail: Request/attempt fields exist; comprehensive cross-path joining not tested.

cpa.detail: Lifecycle and usage RequestID differ; shared TraceID cannot uniquely join nested attempts.

bifrost.detail: Trace hierarchy and agent IDs exist; pooled objects require ownership/copy discipline.

rows.requirement: Distinguish missing usage from measured zero

ccr.detail: Own observer can preserve a presence flag if it sees the original usage payload. Coverage of every relevant path was not established.

cpa.detail: Normalized UsagePlugin record erases absence as zero. An extension can track presence from an earlier raw response/executor path and correlate it; a database reading only UsagePlugin cannot recover it.

bifrost.detail: Own observer can track usage presence when original data is exposed; all provider/trace paths were not established.

rows.original_requirement: Missing usage distinct from measured zero

rows.requirement: Persist telemetry after capture / avoid pre-capture loss

ccr.detail: Own outbox/exporter can durably store received events. Gateway event transforms and hook coverage still determine what reaches it.

cpa.detail: Own database/queue is feasible. Host in-memory usage queue and sequential dispatch remain before the sink; durability after callback cannot prevent pre-callback crash loss.

bifrost.detail: Own collector/outbox is feasible. Inject drops under saturation before callback; choose an earlier capture path or change delivery requirements for lossless audit.

rows.requirement: Explicit policy denial before upstream

ccr.detail: Core beforeAuth/other hooks can reject; outer transform errors alone do not.

cpa.detail: Successful Terminate or explicit auth denial blocks upstream.

bifrost.detail: LLM short-circuit error and HTTP denial; disable fallbacks for mandatory denial.

rows.requirement: Fail-closed mandatory policy on unexpected error

ccr.detail: Core defaults fail_closed; outer transforms fail open and startup can skip failed plugin.

cpa.detail: Interceptor errors fail open; scheduler semantics differ; no global required-role override.

bifrost.detail: LLM errors fail open; HTTP errors differ; no generic mandatory-role guarantee.

rows.original_requirement: Fail-closed mandatory policy on unexpected error

rows.requirement: Bound extension-owned workers / host hook execution

ccr.detail: Own service limits plus existing core per-hook timeout/concurrency/queue policy. Neither forcibly stops unrestricted JS.

cpa.detail: Own admission controls/worker pools are feasible. Generic host guarded calls still create work and cannot forcibly stop native callbacks; host-wide isolation is separate.

bifrost.detail: Own service limits are feasible; host provider/exporter bounds exist. Generic synchronous hooks and built-in tool dispatch still have their own limits/behavior.

rows.requirement: Deterministic extension order

ccr.detail: Named stages and registration order; no dependency DAG established.

cpa.detail: Priority descending then ID; single chosen scheduler with defined fallback rules.

bifrost.detail: Pre hooks forward / post reverse; before/builtin/after placement + order.

rows.requirement: Coordinate cooperating extensions / compactor choice

ccr.detail: One coordinator can own ordering, dependencies and exclusive compactor selection; operator disables competing paths. No host DAG needed. Independently loaded unaware plugins do not gain automatic arbitration.

cpa.detail: One coordinator can own ordering, dependencies and exclusive compactor selection; operator disables competing paths. No host DAG needed. Independently loaded unaware plugins do not gain automatic arbitration.

bifrost.detail: One coordinator can own ordering, dependencies and exclusive compactor selection; operator disables competing paths. No host DAG needed. Independently loaded unaware plugins do not gain automatic arbitration.

rows.requirement: Keep configuration stable for active work

ccr.detail: Own immutable request config and disable/drain hot reload. If live replacement of gateway hook registries is required, whole-request snapshot remains unverified.

cpa.detail: Own config snapshots plus disable/drain reload. Host obtains active sets per hook; one extension cannot make other plugins atomically snapshot.

bifrost.detail: Own config snapshots plus disable/drain reload. Atomic host-wide live swap for an entire request remains unverified.

rows.original_requirement: Stable plugin snapshot for whole request

rows.requirement: Own background jobs and lifecycle

ccr.detail: Run own jobs/queues, retry/outbox workers and health server; stop via plugin cleanup or supervise companion independently. Host job API is optional. Child-process supervision is not automatically supplied.

cpa.detail: Run own jobs/queues, retry/outbox workers and health server; stop via plugin cleanup or supervise companion independently. Host job API is optional. Child-process supervision is not automatically supplied.

bifrost.detail: Run own jobs/queues, retry/outbox workers and health server; stop via plugin cleanup or supervise companion independently. Host job API is optional. Child-process supervision is not automatically supplied.

rows.original_requirement: Host job service available to ordinary plugin

rows.requirement: Sandbox untrusted extension code

ccr.detail: Trusted JS can use OS APIs; a host sandbox is not required by this model. Use process/container permissions if independent service isolation is desired.

cpa.detail: Native C ABI executes trusted code; no host sandbox required here. Companion can use OS/container isolation, which does not sandbox the in-process bridge.

bifrost.detail: Native Go plugin executes trusted code; no host sandbox required here. A separate service can be isolated, but its in-process adapter remains trusted.

rows.original_requirement: Enforced secret / OS sandbox per extension

rows.requirement: Short-circuit cache / local response

ccr.detail: Plugin HTTP routes and policy response handling can answer locally; full cache policy is own work.

cpa.detail: Request termination/custom executor can synthesize response; semantic cache is own work.

bifrost.detail: LLM/HTTP short circuits; built-in cache plugins demonstrate use.

rows.requirement: Run a full extension application plus gateway adapter

ccr.detail: Trusted Node/JS setup can create listeners, databases, workers or companion processes, then register hooks. Outer service has backend registration and stop lifecycle. Other-language services can sit behind a JS adapter.
ccr.basis: Existing audited loader/runtime contract; service packaging not newly executed

cpa.detail: Trusted native plugin initialization can run services/goroutines or communicate with a separately supervised application while registering capabilities. Native ABI adapter required; arbitrary JS projects are not directly loadable.
cpa.basis: Existing audited loader/runtime contract; service packaging not newly executed

bifrost.detail: Trusted Go .so Init/Cleanup can run listeners/workers or connect to a supervised companion while exporting hooks. A language-independent service still needs a compatible Go plugin adapter or SDK host.
bifrost.basis: Existing audited loader/runtime contract; service packaging not newly executed

rows.requirement: Negotiate target capabilities and translate model-specific settings
rows.responsibility: Optional AI runtime validates target-specific capability and translation; extension owns policy/catalog.

ccr.detail: Route resolver and source/target adapters expose conversion seams; no universal semantic capability gate.

cpa.detail: ModelRouter plus target-specific thinking validation, effort/budget conversion and cross-family clamping exist; full capability negotiation and authorized downgrade coverage require integration.

bifrost.detail: PreRequest mutates route and fields with catalog context; hook errors are skipped and SDK key controls are separate.

rows.requirement: Reroute after inspecting an upstream outcome before client commitment
rows.responsibility: Transport owns commit; optional AI runtime coordinates bounded decisions; extension owns validators.

ccr.detail: Payload hooks and error-driven fallback exist; final hooks have path coverage limits.

cpa.detail: Successful nonstream response may be replaced; custom executor can make nested calls but must own safety and coverage.

bifrost.detail: Post hooks can influence errors before fallback; no complete universal content-reroute and commitment guarantee established.

rows.requirement: Coordinate classifier calls, candidate fan-out, hedging and result selection
rows.responsibility: Extension owns planner; optional AI runtime supplies scoped dispatch, accounting and budgets.

ccr.detail: Async resolver and ordered fallback are available; parallel calls need separate orchestration and attribution.

cpa.detail: Custom executor can use host.model.execute and stream callbacks; planner must bound concurrency, cancellation and tool effects.

bifrost.detail: SDK embedding and hook short circuits permit integration; stock shared-object Init receives configuration, not an SDK instance.

rows.requirement: Preserve the client protocol contract across provider/model substitution
rows.responsibility: Optional AI runtime adapters and routing extension; generic transport owns streaming and commitment

ccr.detail: Route resolvers and source/target adapters compose conversion; pair-specific event, error, structured-output and provenance fidelity remains to establish.

cpa.detail: ModelRouter, host execution and stream/nonstream translators expose composition; missing translators can retain raw payload, so each protocol pair needs validation.

bifrost.detail: PreRequestHook routes and PostLLMHook changes typed outputs; RoutingInfo distinguishes requested and attempted models, without establishing complete client-wire fidelity.

rows.requirement: Preserve or migrate conversation affinity and provider-held state when rerouting
rows.responsibility: Extension-owned durable session state and route policy; optional AI runtime validates state on each attempt

ccr.detail: Route resolver and request transforms provide control; Gemini thought signatures have a bounded process-local cache, not general durable state migration.

cpa.detail: Scheduler and host execution can select provider and auth ID; WebSocket loss requests full history, but does not reconstruct state for all reroutes.

bifrost.detail: Route hooks and SDK KeySelector can influence affinity; copied response IDs and fallback routing do not validate cross-account state portability.

rows.requirement: Bind each route change to destination-specific credentials and authorization
rows.responsibility: Generic dispatch enforces per-attempt destination, credential and authorization binding; optional AI runtime covers nested calls and fallbacks; extension owns route and policy.

ccr.detail: Resolvers and provider authenticate can replace targets and upstream requests; per-attempt mandatory policy and redirect credential binding are not established.

cpa.detail: ModelRouter, Scheduler and custom executors select routes and credentials; nested callbacks skip the originating router/interceptor and failure paths can continue.

bifrost.detail: PreRequest mutates routes and SDK KeySelector chooses keys; route-hook errors continue and stock plugin init does not inject SDK Account.

rows.requirement: Separate requested/served route provenance and partition caches accordingly
rows.responsibility: Generic dispatch emits per-attempt provenance; optional AI runtime captures model semantics and usage; extension owns cache and persistence.

ccr.detail: Resolver and billing events expose portions of route and attempt identity; complete immutable provenance and effective-target cache partitioning are not established.

cpa.detail: UsageRecord includes alias, model, provider, base URL and auth ID when available; full nested-attempt joins and cache key coverage remain unproven.

bifrost.detail: RoutingInfo captures requested and per-attempt route/key alias; semantic cache includes scoped hashes but effective endpoint, account and decision-version coverage remain unproven.

scope_note: R01-R43 retain revision-2 classifications; R44-R50 assess complete routing compositions, not absence of their supported primitives. New source review only; no new runtime tests.
